title: BOS-1061 Repo settings → set a repo's organization

scenes.title: the organization field defaults to Personal for an unmapped repo

steps.caption: Press [r] to open the repository list
Press [enter] to open the selected repo's settings
Repository settings visible with the new Organization field

expect.label: the field exists and reads as Personal, not as an empty value
the settings view rendered its other rows, so this is not an empty screen

steps.caption: A repo with no mapping reads as 'None' — a real, default choice rather than an empty state. Its sessions follow the serving daemon's own organization.

scenes.title: the picker lists exactly the caller's organizations

steps.caption: Move down onto the Organization row
Press [enter] to open the organization picker

expect.label: the picker names the setting it is editing
Personal is offered as a real choice, and is current
the caller's first organization, from ListOrganizations
the caller's second organization, from ListOrganizations

steps.caption: The choices are Personal plus exactly the organizations ListOrganizations returned for this caller — nothing invented, nothing dropped.

scenes.title: selecting an organization writes the mapping and the field reflects it

steps.caption: Move down off Personal onto Acme Corp
SetRepoOrganization has returned and the field shows the new mapping

expect.label: the field reflects the organization the user just chose
the Personal default is gone: the write landed rather than silently no-opping

steps.caption: Confirming a choice calls SetRepoOrganization from a returned command — Update itself does no blocking work — and the settled field shows the mapping now in force.
